sloka: तस्मिन् हते भ्रातरि रावणस्य तन्नैर्ऋतानां बलमर्णवाभम्।त्यक्तायुधं केवलजीवितार्थं दुद्राव भिन्नार्णवसन्निकाशम् ।। ६.७०.६२ ।।
transliteration: tasmin hate bhrātari rāvaṇasya tannairṛtānāṁ balamarṇavābham।tyaktāyudhaṁ kevalajīvitārthaṁ dudrāva bhinnārṇavasannikāśam ।। 6.70.62 ।।

translations.english: The monkey was unconscious for a while having fallen on the ground. Regaining senses, overcoming, took up the mace which looked like the rock of a foremost mountain and struck him (Mahaparsva) on the battlefield.
